value: **Involvement**: Teachers collaborated as design partners in collaborative design sessions to provide pedagogical domain expertise, define requirements, evaluate usability, and iteratively refine educational technology tools and online learning environments. **Evidence**: "Data sources included audio-video recordings of interactions, system conversation logs (verbal exchanges between preservice teacher s and virtual students), participatory observation, and teacher reflections."
